title: In JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA before 2026.3, 2026.2.4 sSRF was possible via annotations.xml files during indexing…
description: A Server-Side Request Forgery (sSRF) vulnerability exists in JetBrains IntelliJ IDEA versions before 2026.3 and 2026.2.4. The vulnerability can be triggered via specially crafted annotations.xml files during the indexing process. The CVSS score is low, indicating limited impact primarily on confidentiality with no integrity or availability impact.
